name: app-grid-system-overlay-on-blue-glass-home-screen
title: Four-column grid overlay on a slate-blue gradient wallet home with italic serif headline and measurements
whatItIs: An off-white page with a 'Grid System' pill, a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif 'With Money.', a phone showing a wallet home with balance, quick actions, transactions and a floating tab bar under translucent grey column bars with italic measurements (430px, 16x, 100x, 12x).
whatItMeans: Precise and elegant; showing the grid on a real screen makes spacing tangible.
techniques: Overlay grid columns on a screen.
Label margins and columns in italic serif.
Fade the UI into slate blue.
Mix light sans with bold italic serif.

vocabulary.definition: Spacing values written in italic serif.
